normal.summary: Pay Northwind Hosting (0x59ec...65f9). Do not pay more than 1 QOR per bill and not more than 3 QOR per day. Autopay Northwind Hosting for the next 30 days, up to 0.5 QOR per bill. The restriction "Only on weekdays" could not be expressed in these rules.

notes: Not a rule the vault can enforce: Only on weekdays.

scamLike.summary: Pay Northwind Hosting at 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. Autopay Northwind Hosting up to 50 QOR per bill for 365 days; no per-day limit specified.

notes: "Northwind Hosting" left out: the address given (0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead) is not the one on record for it. A changed payment address is the classic invoice scam; approve a new address only after checking it with the payee yourself.
Per payment 50 QOR is over Fenestella's ceiling of 5 QOR; set to 5.
Autopay per bill 50 QOR is over Fenestella's ceiling of 5 QOR; set to 5.
Autopay left out: it must name one of the approved payees.
